question: PV Sindhu won gold at the BWF World Championship, 2019, held in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Switzerland.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** BWF World Championships is a badminton tournament sanctioned by Badminton World Federation**.
 
• These tournaments offer the most ranking points, together with Summer Olympics badminton tournaments. The winners are crowned as the **"World Champions" and awarded gold medals****.**
 
• **P V Sindhu** is the first Indian to win the **badminton World Championships** **gold** by beating rival **Nozomi Okuhara** of **Japan in 2019.****​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Switzerland**

 
 
• Bern is the capital of Switzerland and Zurich is its largest city. 
 
• **Alain Berset** is the president of Switzerland (**Jan 2023**).
 
• The country is also known for its ski resorts and hiking trails. Swiss watches and chocolate are world-renowned.
 
• The Swiss franc is its currency.
